RESOLUTION NO.
LOAN FROM THE ONE PERCENT SALES TAX CAPITAL PROJECTS
FUND TO THE SPECIAL PURPOSE OPTION SALES TAX CAPITAL
PROJECTS FUND TO FACILITATE THE CONSTRUCTION OF THREE
FIRE STATIONS, PURCHASE FIRE TRUCKS AND REPLACE THE
CEMETERY IRRIGATION SYSTEM AS APPROVED BY VOTERS ON
THENOVEMBER2,2021SIXTH PENNY BALLOT"
WHEREAS, on November 2, 2021 Laramie County voters approved the City of
Cheyenne's Sixth Penny Ballot Proposition #1, which included $15,762,000.00 forbuilding three
fire stations; and
WHEREAS, also on November 2,2021 Laramie County voters approved the City of
Cheyenne's Sixth Penny Ballot Proposition #3, which included $4,262,000.00 for replacing
outdated and unreliable fire trucks; and
WHEREAS, also on November 2, 2021 Laramie County voters approved the City of
Cheyenne's Sixth Penny Ballot Proposition #6, which included $3,090,372.00 for replacing the
City of Cheyenne's 50-year old cemetery irrigation system; and
WHEREAS, tax collections for this proposition willbegin on April 1,2022 and the City
payments until the tax ballot is fully collected; and
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne wishes to begin these three projects as soon as possible
to offset inflationary riskdueto current cost volatility; and
WHEREAS, the City Treasurer completed a cashflow analysis of all approved City of
Cheyenne Sixth Penny Ballot Propositions to determine which projects will require funds before
they are collected; and
WHEREAS, Wyoming Statute S 16-4-117 allows the Governing Body to authorize
interfund loans from one(1)fund to another at interest rates and terms for repayment asit may
prescribe; and
WHEREAS, on December31,2021 the City of Cheyenne's One Percent Sales Tax Capital
Projects Fund has a balance of $52,463,958.06, which is in excess of its cash flow needs; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body wishes to be fiscally prudent with public funds and
recognizes that the use of an interfund loan is preferable to issuing more costly external debt; and
2:
WHEREAS, the One Percent Sales Tax Capital Projects Fund is currently being invested
in the City's portfolio with Federated Hermes, and on December 31,2021 the current interest rate
on those funds was95basispoints(.95%); and
WHEREAS, the One Percent Sales Tax Capital Projects Fund has sufficient resources to
provide an interfund loan to the Special Purpose Option Sales Tax Capital Projects Fund in an
amount not to exceed $14,890,000.00 for payment of costs related to Propositions #1,#3 and #6
of the 2021 Laramie County Sixth Penny Ballot at arate not to exceed 100 basis points (1%).
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY
OFCHEYENNE, WYOMING:
Section 1.
The City Treasurer is authorized to transfer$14,890,000.00 in available cashfrom
the One Percent Sales Tax Capital Projects Fund to the Special Purpose Option
Sales Tax Capital Projects Fund as reflected above.
Section 2.
The terms of theloan are asfollows:
(a)The loan must be repaid within four years from the date of transfer.
(b)Theloan may be prepaid in whole or in part at any time.
(c)Interest shall accrue from the time of the first transfer until theloan has been
fully repaid at a rate equal to100basis points(1%).
